newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hansom mulls sale of stake in venture.
newsitem.headline: Hansom mulls sale of stake in venture.

text.p: Construction concern Hansom Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was in talks on the sale of its stake in a Sino-foreign joint venture company but that the deal would not be a notifiable one.

"The company is in negotiation to dispose its interest in a Sino-foreign cooperative joint venture to an independent third party," the company said in a statement issued through the Hong Kong stock exchange.
"The disposal, based on the terms currently under negotiation, will not constitute a notifiable transaction."
Hansom said it had not yet finalised the terms with the third party, but gave no further details. It did not name the joint venture.
The company also said its consolidated net tangible asset value per share was HK$0.167 as at March 31, 1996.
Shares of Hansom have soared 111 percent in the last three trading days and closed at HK$1.50 on Wednesday.
